answer: Verified Wait-Time Queue.** Each identity must complete real work in a shared queue before acting: a sable task batch is assigned only after sustained idle periods. The garden of pending agents expands with each attempt, so parallel registrations dilute priority across all identities. Crossing the river of eligibility requires cumulative verified uptime, enforced by signed timestamps. An attacker flooding N identities pays N times the queue delay plus wasted labor, since none accrue priority until the full wait elapses.
